prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your business, goals, channels, budget and culture fit. To help, here’s a quick framework plus a short list of well-regarded agencies with different strengths, and what I’d need from you to recommend the best matches.

Quick candidates (strong SF / Bay‑Area presence or that serve SF clients)
- AKQA — digital product, UX/experience design and brand-driven campaigns  
- R/GA — creative + technology, large-brand digital campaigns and product work  
- Huge — digital transformation, CX and experience design for mid‑large brands  
- Metric Theory — performance marketing (PPC/paid social) and e‑commerce growth  
- 3Q Digital — paid search, programmatic, analytics-driven performance marketing  
- Jellyfish — paid media, SEO and training; global agency with SF team  
- MightyHive (Accenture/partner) — programmatic, video and analytics specialist  
- Tinuiti — e‑commerce and performance across marketplaces, paid and social  
- Single Grain — growth marketing and acquisition-focused for startups and scaleups

How to pick the “best” for you
- Goal: brand awareness, lead generation, growth/Hack, e‑commerce, or SEO/CRO?  
- Industry: B2B SaaS, consumer, healthcare, fintech, regulated industries?  
- Channels: paid search, social ads, programmatic, SEO, email, marketplaces, creative?  
- Budget & timeline: monthly retainer or project / pilot? Target CPA/ROAS?  
- Size/style: big network agency vs boutique specialist vs freelance growth team  
- Proof: ask for case studies with KPIs, client references, team who will work on your account, tech stack and reporting cadence

If you want, tell me:
- your business type (B2B/B2C), industry, monthly marketing budget, primary goals, and top 2 channels — and I’ll give a tailored shortlist of 3 agencies in San Francisco (or remote firms serving SF) with reasons why they’d fit and suggested questions to ask them.
